avis.texte: I bought this product recommended by friends in Europe with lots of hope. Unfortunately, made my baby's eczema worse, spreaded it all over her hody, made it inflamed. I was so surprised and disappointed after all good things I've heard and read. I spent a fortune since A derma is not on the US market, im returning it along with unopened bath oil I bought as well and im gonna pay about 30$ out of my pocket to send it back to Portugal. Be careful what you use on your baby's skin, they are so sensitive at this early age. Even specialy created formula for eczema and atopic skin dont always work. Try Theraplex emollient, amazing p4oduct and it is w8rth every penny.

avis.titre: this is not the body balm, this is the body lotion
avis.texte: The title for this item is not translated correctly. This item is listed as the emollient balm but the item in the picture is the "body milk" not the balm. I ordered it and disappointingly received the body milk, I thought I was purchasing the much thicker and richer balm. I have tried both the balm and this body lotion to combat eczema and this lotion does not work for that purpose.

avis.titre: Soothing and Moisturizing for Sensitive Skin
avis.texte: A-derma Exomega Emollient Balm in a generous 400ml bottle is a game-changer for those with dry or sensitive skin. This rich balm quickly soothes irritation and deeply moisturizes, providing long-lasting comfort. It’s formulated with natural plant extracts, making it safe for both adults and children with delicate skin. The balm absorbs well without leaving a greasy residue, making it ideal for daily use. Highly recommended for its effective relief and protective properties.

This is the only moisturiser that I've found works on my very dry, sensitive skin. Yes it is very greasy and if I need to dress quickly after my shower I prefer to use the cream version as it absorbs more quickly but nothing works as well as the balm. My skin rarely cracks now and is far less itchy than it used to be. I also don't have to use prescription steroid creams as much. I would find it hard to do without.
